systems.system: Centre national algerien des prestations numeriques (data centre, Algiers and Blida)

DZA.note: Data centre agreed with Huawei in April 2024, not in service or for hire.

facts.fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation said the national data centre, agreed with Huawei in April 2024, will hold a national interoperability platform to interconnect sectoral ministry systems, with a national database and portal.

systems.platform: Centre national algerien des prestations numeriques

facts.fact: The High Commission for Digitalisation said the national data centre agreed in April 2024 aims to achieve digital sovereignty and the domiciliation of national data.
facts.system: Centre national algerien des prestations numeriques

facts.fact: The minister and High Commissioner for Digitalisation announced that the Presidency adopted the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030, covering five axes and 25 objectives.
The High Commission said the strategy document will be explained and published later.

DZA.note: The national data centre is being built, not in service.
